title: Add human release review gate for A2A repair automation
summary: A2A delegated repair automation is still in hardening and should not expand beyond current evidence without an explicit human release review. Add a lightweight decision record plus a validator/config guard so enabling expanded repair automation requires an acknowledged review.
expectedFailureModes: Expanded delegated repair automation is enabled without any durable human review evidence.
Docs claim a human release review exists but the runtime has no guard that enforces it.
The guard is too strict or unclear, blocking intended opt-in test coverage without a documented override.
nextAction: Define a decision record and enforcement hook that keeps expanded A2A repair automation gated behind an explicit human review marker.
